system.description:
Faun Traits

Characters with the faun heritage share a variety of traits with one another.

Fey Lineage. You are suffused with the vibrant energy of the faerie realms. Your creature type is fey in addition to humanoid.

Age. Fauns age and mature at a similar rate to humans, though they live slightly longer, reaching ages of 200 years.

Size. Fauns typically range between 4–5 feet tall and weigh no more than 200 lbs. Your size is Medium.

Speed. Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

Fey Resilience. Your fey ancestry makes it easier for you to resist the wiles of others. You gain an expertise die on saving throws to resist being charmed.

Hardy Hooves. You have a pair of cloven hooves instead of bare feet, meaning you cannot wear regular footwear such as boots and other shoes. However, your hooves are naturally hard and tough. Choose one type of terrain your goat-like lower half is adapted to: arctic, desert, forest, grassland, or mountain. You ignore naturally-occurring difficult terrain in that environment. You also take half damage from sharp terrain hazards, such as sharp rocks or broken glass.

Faun Gifts

In addition to the traits found in your faun heritage, select one of the following gifts.

Lead Belly

You may consume a number of small, nonmagical objects made of wood, leather, cloth, or some other natural material equal to your Constitution modifier to satisfy your daily Supply.

Additionally, you gain an expertise die on saving throw made to resist ingested poisons.

Mountain Climber

You gain proficiency in Athletics, or an expertise die if you were already proficient.

Additionally, you are able to scale vertical rock or stone surfaces without the use of aids such as pitons or climbing gear. When scaling a rocky surface (such as a mountainside or a stone wall) you gain a climb speed equal to your Speed.

Fainting Repose

When you would fail a Constitution saving throw versus a maneuver, spell, or spell-like effect, you may instead expend your reaction to faint and fall out of the way. You fall prone as a result, but any effects you would experience are experienced as if you had succeeded the saving throw instead. Once you have used this ability, you may not do so again until you complete a long rest.

Faun Paragon

When you reach 10th level, you become a better faun and gain one paragon gift from the following list.

Arcane Appetite

Prerequisite: Lead Belly heritage gift

You may consume one wondrous magic item of your choosing. This item may not be legendary or an artifact, and it cannot be sentient.

Once you have consumed an item in this fashion, you gain an additional attunement slot that is dedicated to that item. This attunement lasts until you consume another wondrous item, at which point the original magic item is destroyed and its attunement is replaced with the new item.

Caprine Nimbleness

Once per day, you may choose to gain two bonus actions on your turn. Once you have used this ability, you may not do so again until you complete a long rest.

Keep Your Feet

You may cast the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.lhj6nj6kzuptkr2x]{Solid Ground} without expending a spell slot. Once you have used this ability, you may not do so again until you complete a long rest.
